terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of ToDo. By creating an account you agree to them.
terms.s1: You must give a real email address or mobile number and verify it. Keep your password private. You are responsible for what happens in your account.
terms.s2: Do not use ToDo to harass, threaten or abuse anyone; to share sexual content, content involving children, or anything illegal; to spam people; to pretend to be someone else; or to plan or carry out a crime. Do not try to break into other accounts or disrupt the service.
terms.s3: If you break these rules we may remove content and suspend or close your account. We keep removed content and related records for at least 180 days, as Indian law requires, and may share them with authorities when the law requires it.
terms.s4: Your tasks are yours. You let us store and show them to you and the people you share them with, only to run the service.
terms.s5: Contact our grievance officer (see the Grievance contact page). We acknowledge complaints within 24 hours and aim to resolve them within 7 days.
terms.s6: We will tell you before these terms change in a way that matters.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data ToDo collects, why, and the choices you have, in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.s1: Your name, email and/or mobile number, password (stored only as a secure hash), profile photo, language, theme and time zone; the tasks you create; and security records such as sign-in times, device type and IP address.
privacy.s2: To run your account and show you your tasks, to send one-time codes, to keep the service secure, and to meet legal duties. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacy.s3: Service providers that run ToDo for us (hosting, email and SMS delivery, file storage, error tracking), under contracts. Authorities, only when Indian law requires it.
privacy.s4: While your account is open. When you delete something, it is hidden immediately and permanently deleted after 180 days. When you delete your account, your sign-up details are kept in encrypted form for 180 days, as the IT Rules require, then deleted.
privacy.s5: You can see and correct your details in Settings, download your data, withdraw consent by deleting your account, and complain to our grievance officer or to the Data Protection Board of India.
privacy.s6: Data is encrypted in transit, passwords are hashed with Argon2, and access to stored data is limited and logged.

grievance.title: Grievance contact
grievance.intro: If you have a complaint about content, your account or your data, contact our grievance officer.
grievance.timelines: We acknowledge every complaint within 24 hours and aim to resolve it within 7 days.
grievance.include: Please include your registered email or mobile number and a short description. Do not send your password or any code.
